The approver set deployed: the reason is not_in_set, not set_empty, so NITRD_APPROVERS was non-empty in the running app.
The control discriminates on identity on the deployed tool path: it refused this caller because the identity it received is not listed, not because it refuses everything blind.

The positive side on the deployed app is row 10 (/operator/decide, which shares check 0) and row 11 (agent approve route), both still to be run.
Header integrity for service principals is still an inference: the spoof test ran on a human sign-in only.
